bio.text: Mike Minogue won the Republican nomination for Governor of Massachusetts in the September 1, 2026 primary and faces Gov. Maura Healey in the November general election.
A former biotech executive, he led the medical device company Abiomed for close to two decades.
Minogue is a West Point graduate and Army veteran who was awarded a Bronze Star for his service in Operation Desert Storm in 1991.

sources.title: Minogue defeats GOP rival Shortsleeve, setting up clash with Healey
